940009.title: Ray Gunn
940009.overview: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder, and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

977961.title: To Die to Live
977961.overview: In 2014, Shakhta, Dancer, and Potter volunteered for the army in order to fight in the Russo-Ukrainian conflict in eastern Ukraine. Although the horrible things they experienced during two years on the front accompany them for every second of their existence, they try to return to civilian life. But the Russian invasion in 2022 forces them to again confront the war.

1012137.title: Fantomas: The New World
1012137.overview: Paris, 1914: Fantomas, a master of deception and chaos, is being chased by Lieutenant Juve as he investigates a series of violent crimes that have put the city on edge. In an era of violence and political tensions, Lieutenant Juve finds himself hunting for a man with no motive, no agenda, no pattern or identity.
1012137.trailerName: Fantomas - The New World / Fantômas - Le Nouveau Monde (2027) - Teaser (English subs)

1090025.title: Le Faux Soir
1090025.overview: November 1943, German-occupied Belgium. In the face of grave danger if caught, the Independent Front, a Belgian resistance organization, publishes a spoof edition of Le Soir to satirize the German occupiers and the nation’s main propaganda-controlled newspaper. Le Faux Soir is considered the first act of media hacking in history.

1116201.title: Iron Lung
1116201.overview: The stars are gone. The planets have disappeared. Only individuals aboard space stations or starships were left to give the end a name -- The Quiet Rapture. After decades of decay and crumbling infrastructure, the Consolidation of Iron has made a discovery on a barren moon designated AT-5. An ocean of blood. Hoping to discover desperately needed resources they immediately launch an expedition. A submarine is crafted and a convict is welded inside. Due to the pressure and depth of the ocean the forward viewport has been encased in metal. If successful, they will earn their freedom. If not, another will follow. This will be the 13th expedition.

1140521.title: The Magic Faraway Tree
1140521.overview: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

1227241.title: Maa Inti Bangaram
1227241.overview: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.
1227241.trailerName: Maa Inti Bangaaram Teaser Trailer | Samantha | Raj Nidimoru | Nandini | Diganth | Santhosh Narayanan

1228841.title: Objet a
1228841.overview: Ingeborg and Adam are visionary hand surgeons bound by love, control, and irresistible fixations. She is compelled to steal objects; he longs to become one. When an accident brings the enigmatic Gaia into their lives, unexpected desires begin to take shape, unsettling the careful balance that has long defined their relationship.

1260649.title: Jumanji: Open World
1260649.overview: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us - as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

1263337.title: Heart of the Beast
1263337.overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

1264169.title: Criadas
1264169.overview: Sandra returns to her cousin Mariana’s house in search of a photo of her late mother, who worked as a live-in maid for Mariana’s parents. Although they were raised together, Sandra, a dark-skinned Black woman, and Mariana, a light-skinned Black woman, experienced that house in vastly different ways. Their reunion forces them to confront long buried memories, issues of race, family, and belonging, while a supernatural force lurks around them.

1287145.title: Madfabulous
1287145.overview: When the flamboyant Henry Paget arrives in 1890s North Wales to claim his aristocratic inheritance, his theatrical flair and defiant eccentricities send shockwaves through the upper-class elite, much to the amusement of the local townspeople. Alongside his spirited cousin, Lily, and loyal butler, Gelert, Henry tries to carve out his own identity as the Fifth Marquess, navigating suffocating traditions, scheming relatives, and the long shadow cast by his estranged father.

1299049.title: Wovon sollen wir träumen
1299049.overview: While handing out food at a charity organization, Laura, Evîn and Julia unexpectedly cross paths. Laura, a released prisoner, defends Evîn, a Kurdish woman, when she is racially insulted by a man waiting in line. Eventually the situation gets out of hand.

1303657.title: Allegro Pastell
1303657.overview: In the summer of 2018, novelist Tanja Arnheim and web designer Jerome Daimler have a seemingly ideal long-distance relationship in the heat of Berlin, the idyll of an inherited bungalow in the Hessian Main Valley and many train journeys in between. But the carefully cultivated balance of trust and detachment between the two hyper-reflective millennials is shaken when Tanja realizes on the night of her thirtieth birthday that the relationship could become existential.

1319977.title: Nothing Personal
1319977.overview: Lina, a well-known TV host, appears at Pedro’s doorstep to confront him about a cruel message he posted about her online. What begins as a showdown soon turns into an awkward living arrangement that quietly reshapes them both.

1323625.title: Night Patrol
1323625.overview: An L.A. cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighborhood in danger.

1364137.title: Dirty Hands
1364137.overview: In the underbelly of Chicago, a routine drug deal goes bad for the Denton brothers, Richie and Danny. With a kingpin’s son murdered, a rival gang out for blood, and their own boss trying to clean up their mess, the brothers must fight for their lives if they’re going to survive until morning.

1376681.title: Killing Time
1376681.overview: In an era of economic despair and record-high unemployment, where becoming a YouTuber is the ultimate dream job, the popular YouTube crew 'Killing Time' collapses overnight after an unforeseen accident claims a team member's life during a live broadcast. Desperate for a successful comeback, the members plot to return with far more extreme and sensational content. However, just as success seems within reach, mysterious figures appear and propose the 'real' Killing Time.

1378537.title: Mirzapur: The Movie
1378537.overview: The battle for Mirzapur’s throne intensifies as old enemies resurface and a new threat emerges in the form of Babban Babua, a ruthless businessman from Jaisalmer with ambitions of his own. As the Tripathis face enemies from both the past and present, loyalties are tested while Guddu and Bablu Pandit fight to establish themselves in the power struggle for Mirzapur.

1397737.title: Only Beautiful Things to Look At
1397737.overview: Ingrid works as a gynecologist in a district hospital in Slovakia in the late 1980s. Her marriage is at a standstill, she has an affair with a younger colleague in the hospital, and after work, she sits on the abortion committee where they offer Roma women sterilization after the abortion is approved. Eighteen-year-old Agáta, who grew up in a children’s home, comes to work as a nurse at the hospital. Ingrid unexpectedly becomes close to her.

1398505.title: Jani's December
1398505.overview: Following her sister’s sudden flight from the household, a young woman acts as a clandestine intermediary between the runaway and their deeply fractured family, culminating in a critical four-day ultimatum where she must choose between sibling loyalty and the transparent truth required for domestic healing.

1404521.title: Chinna Chinna Aasai

With exclusive footage capturing critical meetings, private conversations, and never-before-seen environments, Mrs. Trump returns to one of the world's most powerful roles.

1415913.title: The Obelisk
1415913.overview: While fighting for survival in the wilds of the Northeast, a drifter unites with a mysterious veteran to expose the truth of America’s demise.

1421609.title: Now I Met Her
1421609.overview: An 18-year-old discovers his late mother’s diary and begins piecing together the exuberant, complicated life she once led.

1422441.title: 5 More Minutes

Just before he leaves, however, the entire world slips into a time loop, and the last five minutes begin to repeat endlessly.

1425257.title: The Last Solution

1445033.title: Kaalidas 2

What begins as a routine missing-person case quickly turns dark when the child and a dog are found murdered. As more mysterious killings occur in the same building, Kaalidas uncovers hidden secrets among the residents and races against time to stop a killer before more live

1450473.title: Hippo Love
1450473.overview: Two strangers meet at a Greek-Finnish wedding while going through their own breakups. Touko, a musician who has had little success and is still married, feels attracted to Eevis, who is in the process of getting divorced. Touko's wife, the famous singer Leena, is also a guest at the wedding and notices the attraction between Touko and Eevis. Amidst the stunning Greek seascapes, the conversations that take place over the course of one evening touch on parenthood, childlessness, sex, divorce, marriage, and, of course, love, while the guests celebrate a memorable wedding.

1458857.overview: A single mother fighting for survival and a reformed ex-con with untapped talents forge an unexpected bond.

1462889.title: Drunken Noodles
1462889.overview: Adnan, a young art student, arrives in New York to spend the summer in an apartment. He interns at a gallery that exhibits the work of an older, unconventional artist he once crossed paths with. As moments from his past and present intertwine, a series of encounters, both artistic and erotic, open gaps in his everyday reality.

1483625.title: Mom and Dad are Gods
1483625.overview: In a clash of distant centuries and cultures, two children from the 7th century awaken inside a mystical cave from a thousand-year slumber into the chaotic 21st century. Along with them, two ancient Slavic gods rise, incarnating themselves as the parents of Petr and Simona, siblings from the 21st century, leading to countless entertaining adventures in which the four children join forces and bridge the gap between old and new times, cultures, and customs to save the souls of their parents, who are currently unbearably divine.
1483625.trailerName: Máma a Táta jsou Boží (2026) - TEASER

1511081.title: Contention
1511081.overview: Siblings are taken hostage by a young girl with mysterious abilities. However, their captor is on the run from a cunning man who is hellbent on returning the girl to her prison.

1514601.title: Songs of the Djinns
1514601.overview: "Songs of the Djinns" is a fairy tale about magic. On New Year's Eve two actresses wander the streets of Varanasi. Meanwhile, in Goa, preparations are underway for a musical event featuring pop stars. One day, they will all find themselves on a ship, taking turns telling their stories. The ship will sail down a quiet river, and on the shore, everyone will be listening in carefully: bats in ruined palaces, wandering conjurers, and touring DJs. They need to hear the singing of the djinns.

1517161.title: Broken English
1517161.overview: A survivor, provocateur and true original, Marianne has spent more than six decades defying expectations — releasing over thirty-five albums while constantly reinventing herself. Made with her full involvement, Broken English is an intimate and unflinching exploration of a fractured yet unbreakable life shaped by fame, creativity and relentless public scrutiny.

1517865.title: Vanished in an Instant
1517865.overview: After her daughter disappears from a gas station, a mother's race against time uncovers a chilling truth buried beneath a quiet town's surface.

1523433.title: Времена любви
1523433.overview: Artem and Tanya are a young couple who separated a few weeks ago. Despite the breakup, they continue to live together in a rented apartment, unable to separate. Despite the chasm of disappointment and misunderstanding that has arisen, strong feelings remain between the couple. Another argument shatters the unbearable circumstances of their protracted separation. However, the question of "how to be together" hangs over the lovers like an unsettling shadow of indecipherability. Trying to answer it, they spend a long night in the confined space of their apartment. Recalling a past they can no longer return and imagining a future that frightens them with its uncertainty, Tanya and Artem wish to grasp the present, where they can live happily together.

1524393.title: La Catastrophe
1524393.overview: In a sumptuous lakeside hotel, the perfect routine falters when disaster strikes.

1529513.title: Kong Tao
1529513.overview: Local property developer Song Longchen secretly employs black magic—known as Hexing—to seize control of valuable land parcels. His schemes leave behind a trail of unexplained deaths, which authorities dismiss as mere accidents due to widespread skepticism toward the supernatural.

1529833.title: Dinosaur Hunt
1529833.overview: A rich family are brought together to a remote island for a reunion, only to learn that their father has been experimenting with dinosaurs in an attempt to find a cure for his disease. This family are forced to work together when the dinosaurs escape.

1539177.title: Magenta House
1539177.overview: Many would tell you that Magenta House is the pinnacle of progression: wonder drug medications, humane living conditions and frequent, compassionate therapy sessions... but something darker exists beneath the surface. When five patients escape from the experimental health facility, all will take wildly different approaches to their brief reintroduction to society. But one thing is for certain - The cats out the bag now, and nothing will ever be the same...

1547881.title: VENDETTA-BEAST MODE
1547881.overview: From pain to power, hero evolves into deadly Beast Mode.

1554345.title: This Bloody Country
1554345.overview: In 1869, a family leaves Salt Lake City on an arduous journey to establish a new outpost of their church. They cart all their belongings, leaving safety behind. The terrain is rough and unforgiving. When an encounter with dangerous men turns violent, their attempt to flee proves futile. Left with no other choice, they must prepare to defend themselves from an expected attack. Their pursuers hold the advantage because a party of mostly women and children are no match for outlaws in the wild country… unless they are.

1572073.title: The Deadly Little Mermaid
1572073.overview: Some secrets are better left at the bottom of the ocean. Once she's in your house, there is no escape. When a struggling artist pulls a beautiful, unconscious woman from the freezing coastal waters, he thinks he’s performed a miracle. But as she recovers within the walls of his secluded home, a series of unsettling events leads him to a terrifying realization: her presence is no coincidence. She is inextricably linked to the same watery grave that claimed his family years ago.

1573673.title: It's Time to Grow Up
1573673.overview: Shortly before her birthday dinner, attended by her immediate family, Margaret, a highly sensitive young girl, writes a phrase once whispered to her by her grandmother in her private journal: “It’s Time to Grow Up.”

1575273.title: Don't Let The Bastards Grind You Down
1575273.overview: "Don't Let The Bastards Grind You Down" is a documentary film about British social policy. The focus is on the political struggle against neoliberal austerity policies, which have their origins in the hated Thatcher government.  The film features the former socialist MP Dave Nellist, who is now the national chair of the Trade Unionist & Socialist Coalition and Hannah Sell, the general secretary of the Socialist Party. The film features a local election campaign in the miners' town of Nuneaton, students campaigning against an increase in tuition fees and refuse workers from Birmingham striking against massive cuts to their wages.

1575337.title: Cosmic Princess Kaguya!
1575337.overview: Iroha's life gets knocked off its orbit when Kaguya, a carefree runaway from the Moon, moves in and convinces her to perform in a virtual world together.

1592105.title: Между нами, девочками
1592105.overview: Three friends, Naika, Zhenya, and Alisa, embark on a traditional spa weekend to escape their routine and family roles, but especially their mothers-in-law. Their plans are ruined when Naika's future mother-in-law, Margarita Pavlovna, unexpectedly joins them, and the three friends' escape from reality and everyday life turns into a true test of their friendship. It turns out they all view life differently.

1594729.title: Enemy in My House
1594729.overview: Enemy in My House is a live-filmed stage play blending mystery, suspense, comedy, faith, and an unforgettable twist. Journalist Monique Daniels is newly married, expecting her first child, and grateful to God for her many blessings—until Harmony, a new assistant from the news station, enters her life.  What begins as casual workdays quietly spirals into daily drama as secrets, sabotage, and temptation rise to the surface. Someone is determined to destroy Monique’s family, her career, and her peace. As the tension escalates, her instincts as an investigative journalist sharpen, drawing her into a dangerous search for the truth.  In a gripping unraveling of deception, Monique is forced to confront a devastating reality: the news anchor isn’t just reporting the headline—she’s become it.  A tense, emotional roller coaster captured live on stage, Enemy in My House delivers powerful performances, sharp storytelling, and a shocking ending that leaves audiences breathless.
1594729.trailerName: Enemy in My House | Official Trailer

1595689.title: F.-M. Banier filmé par A. Arietta
1595689.overview: In 2015, Arrietta portrayed his friend François-Marie Banier — his studio, his photographs, his paintings — with a Mekas-like freshness and cheerful detachment. Ten years on, a visit to a country house adds another piece to the fragmentary account of a life shaped by encounters and friendships.

1596393.title: Chhaki Suna
1596393.overview: Each victim holds a piece of the puzzle, but solving this deadly game could make the investigator the final player.

1600617.title: Dead Dogs Don't Bite

1607593.title: The Raid

Night after night he searches for answers, but the closer he gets to the truth, the less it seems to make sense. Soon the line between watcher and watched begins to dissolve.

1621673.title: Sukiyaki
1621673.overview: The story centers around the life and friendship of the 689 Trio (songwriter Nakamura Hachidai, lyricist Ei Rokusuke and singer Sakamoto Kyu).

Clues turn to consequences. And the truth… refuses to stay hidden.

1633513.overview: When her teenage daughter dies under mysterious circumstances, a mother's search for truth unravels a chain of lies and betrayal among her closest friends, forcing her to confront evil in her own circle.

1642665.title: Anthony
1642665.overview: Set along the coastal shores of Jaffna, the story follows a fisherman and his family  whose lives are inseparably tied to the sea. As he struggles to balance his responsibilities toward his profession and his family, a tender love story unfolds, shaping his choices and testing his values. Daily life within the fishing community  its hardships, traditions, and unspoken bonds, forms the backdrop of the narrative. When personal desires begin to clash with family expectations, the protagonist is forced to confront sacrifice, loyalty, and the true meaning of love. Through moments of romance, conflict, and emotional depth, the film reveals the  strength of family ties and the resilience of a community that survives by trusting the sea and each other.

1646057.title: LOVESTRUCK
1646057.overview: During a date night between Audrey (Jordan Baker) and Henry (Benjamin Sears) a crazed ex of Audrey’s breaks in to pursue Audrey, killing anyone who gets in his way.

1647785.title: Алмаз «Сердце Персии»
1647785.overview: The Cyrus the Great Diamond is stolen from an excavation site in Iran and falls into the hands of a Russian boy vacationing at the seaside with his family.

1648489.title: Future Tense
1648489.overview: In a dystopian future, a young couple clashes during their time-traveling vacation.

1650153.title: Miami Magic
1650153.overview: Nora has been living in NYC, following her dreams of “aspiring comedy writer,” but teaching took over, a job she’s just quit or been fired from — it’s complicated. Before she can figure out her next move, Nora finds herself back home, in Miami– Kendall, to be exact, dressed as a dancing grape, performing at children’s birthday parties with her Abuela and Tio.  This particular party turns out to be Nora’s worst anxiety nightmare come to life. All of her high school nemesis, crushes, and most memorable classmates are there, watching her fail. Except, maybe she’s not failing at all. Maybe she’s just growing, transitioning from one version of herself to a better one. And maybe, just maybe, those Octo/Nonagenarians she’s working with might have something to teach her after all.

1650281.title: Gemini
1650281.overview: As a career-defining performance approaches, a young composer becomes unsettled by a piece of music that seems to surface unbidden, drawing him into a confrontation with his own self-doubt.

1651177.title: Landa
1651177.overview: Portrait of Alfredo Landa, Spanish cinema's most popular actor. From landismo to his greatest roles, featuring public affection, prestigious awards, unreleased material, and intimate testimonies about the person behind the performer

1653929.title: Bach: Passion Oratorio - Il Gardellino Ensemble
1653929.overview: As the leader of the Il Gardellino ensemble, harpsichordist Alexander Grychtolik performs and conducts Bach’s “Passion Oratorio,” a project that had been abandoned by the cantor. Based on the libretto written by the poet Picander, the musician conducted extensive research to reconstruct the score, parts of which were later incorporated into the “St. Matthew Passion.”

1654313.title: Unanswered//butterfly
1654313.overview: The world’s first full-dive VRMMO, Sword Art Online—known as SAO. What was meant to be a dream come true has instead transformed into a deadly game where dying in the virtual world means dying in reality. Emirun and Rex, who once knew each other in the real world, reunite by chance within SAO. They join a scouting party to learn how to survive in this unforgiving world. One day, however, they encounter a mysterious PK known only as the Black Swordsman. When Emirun rushes to the scene, she finds Rex collapsed in despair, and the Black Swordsman standing over him. The one who wiped out their entire scouting party... was the Black Swordsman! Determined to avenge their fallen comrades, Emirun and Rex seek out the legendary prodigy swordswoman Asuna, and begin intense training under her guidance. In a death game where even players turn against one another, what new beginning will these two reach at the end of their struggle…?

1655529.title: Bigger Picture
1655529.overview: An overprotective mum, a taciturn dad and a creative crisis? Arek Pasożyt really has his work cut out for him! In search of inspiration, he heads off to the Tatra Mountains. There, he stumbles upon a clue leading to the Panorama of the Tatras — the largest painting in Polish history, which went missing 130 years ago. Arek decides to find it.

1656489.title: Sultana
1656489.overview: Sultana is a drama set in Istanbul's one and only strip club, telling a story of a women, power, rivalry and solidarity. A new Turkish story where women are not victims in a fairy tale, but warriors learning that the 'handsome prince' is often the real monster- and their only salvation is each other. Meral the long reigning queen of the one and only strip club of Istanbul which is Sultana, takes a talented new Belarusian dancer named Anna under her wing. But she soon realizes she has created a rival powerful enough to replace her, and a ruthless power struggle erupts between the two women.

1658217.title: Sawsawan
1658217.overview: Karen plays Dolor, a street food vendor with big dreams. Men flock Dolor's stall not just for her dipping sauce but for the secret pleasure that comes with it.
1658217.trailerName: SAWSAWAN | OFFICIAL TRAILER | WORLD PREMIERE THIS APRIL 10 ONLY ON VMX

1660905.title: Dead Air
1660905.overview: On the anniversary of her renowned musician sister's death, a young radio presenter revisits her unreleased demo tapes in the studio for a documentary and finds herself haunted by the guilt of her past sins. Based on 'The Raven' and 'The Tell-tale Heart' by Edgar Allan Poe.

1666089.title: Fragments of Belonging
1666089.overview: Tatjana is lonely. Born in Croatia, she has lived across Europe before settling in Amsterdam. Fifteen years later, her teenage son avoids bringing friends home, embarrassed by her dreadful Slavic accent and her lack of Dutch composure. But the real trouble is bigger: Tatjana feels foreign everywhere. Determined to belong, she starts knocking on doors across Europe, asking relatives and friends how they did it. Stumbling through cultural misfires and everyday bias, she finally confronts a dark pattern in her own family history.

1666601.title: Pictoman
1666601.overview: After a violent car crash, a succsesful musician begins to rethink his life choices and rediscover personal meaning. However, his transformation may not just be exclusively spiritual.

1669929.title: The Gold Trail
1669929.overview: Fafner, a mercenary anti-hero, descends upon a city torn by conflict, relentlessly tracking a trail of coins that will lead him toward his inevitable fate.

1675177.title: Chris & Martina: The Final Set
1675177.overview: Tennis legends Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova reflect on their parallel journeys to sports stardom while delving into their rivalry and friendship, especially as the duo continue to support each other through their shared experience of cancer treatment.

1675753.title: Hundertzwölf

1679401.title: Top Hat - The Musical

Irving Berlin’s irresistible score includes some of Hollywood’s greatest songs, including the immortal Cheek to Cheek, Let’s Face the Music and Dance, Top Hat White Tie and Tails and Puttin’ on the Ritz.  When Broadway star Jerry Travers arrives in London to open a new show, he crosses paths with model Dale Tremont whose beauty sleep is rudely interrupted by Jerry tap dancing in the hotel suite above hers. Instantly smitten, Jerry vows to abandon his bachelor life to win her – but the path of true love never does run smooth.  Put on your top hat, brush off your tails and let this joyous romantic musical comedy sweep you off your feet!

As fans and colleagues mistake her for her fictional alter-ego, stripping her of her individuality, she enters an internal struggle to reclaim her essence, challenging the limits between fiction and the reality of her own existence and fighting to take control of her destiny before disappearing completely under the shadow of her character.

As power, lies, and old grudges intertwine, Jiale has no choice but to return to the underworld. Along the way, he saves Jiehe, a girl with a music dream on the verge of despair, and she becomes a glimmer of light in his dark life. To protect the ones he cherishes and account for his past, he picks up the knife again. A thrilling gunfight breaks out in the dark alleys of the city, and he turns the tables time and again with his skills. Tearing off Huoshan's disguise, the truth from eight years ago comes to light.

In Sicily, where the future often feels like a futile wait, a UFO sighting becomes an opportunity to measure the distance between reality and hope. An ironic exploration of the human need to believe and the urge to look beyond.
